stories.h: Likud–Yashar unity talks stall over Ben-Gvir, premiership
stories.s: After four-plus hours in Herzliya, Likud rejected Eisenkot's demand to exclude Ben-Gvir; the sides agreed only on opposing a Palestinian state. Another round is set for Monday evening at the Knesset, as Likud accuses Yashar of staging talks.

stories.h: Haredi parties' draft talks with Eisenkot rattle right-wing bloc
stories.s: The ultra-Orthodox parties are negotiating a conscription arrangement with Eisenkot's camp, with reports of progress but no deal. A senior right-wing official warned their decades-long alliance with Netanyahu may be breaking.

stories.h: Katz pushes police takeover of settler-violence cases
stories.s: After another weekend of attacks on Palestinians, Defense Minister Katz renewed his bid to shift West Bank Jewish extremism cases from the army to police, while still refusing administrative detention. President Herzog called the violence despicable.

stories.h: New Knesset majority forms oversight panels amid shouting match
stories.s: The Knesset approved a committee on attorney-general legislation and four oversight panels, 11–9. A hearing on Democrats MK Gilad Kariv chairing the law committee descended into clashes between bereaved families and lawmakers.
